what.en: A road accident is when a car, motorcycle, or other vehicle hits a person or another vehicle. Following road rules helps prevent it.
what.fil: Ang aksidente sa daan ay kapag may kotse, motorsiklo, o ibang sasakyan na bumangga sa tao o sa ibang sasakyan. Nakatutulong ang pagsunod sa batas trapiko para maiwasan ito.

signs.en: Accidents happen in seconds. Watch for fast or turning vehicles, and follow traffic lights, road signs, and traffic enforcers' signals.
signs.fil: Ilang segundo lang, maaaring may maaksidente. Bantayan ang mabibilis o lumiliko na sasakyan, at sundin ang traffic light, road sign, at senyas ng traffic enforcer.

before.en: Learn what road signs and pedestrian signals mean. Always buckle your seat belt, and if you are 12 or younger, sit in the back seat.
before.fil: Alamin ang kahulugan ng road sign at pedestrian signal. Laging mag-seatbelt, at kung 12 taong gulang ka pababa, umupo sa likod.

during.en: Look left and right before you cross! Use the pedestrian lane or overpass, follow the signals, and never run or use gadgets while crossing.
during.fil: Tumingin sa kaliwa at kanan bago tumawid! Gumamit ng pedestrian lane o overpass, sundin ang mga senyas, at huwag tumakbo o mag-gadget habang tumatawid.

after.en: If you see an accident, stay on the sidewalk and away from traffic. Tell an adult or a traffic enforcer right away so they can call for help.
after.fil: Kapag may nakita kang aksidente, manatili sa bangketa at lumayo sa mga sasakyan. Sabihan agad ang nakatatanda o traffic enforcer para makatawag sila ng tulong.

signoff.en: Remember: stop, look left and right, then cross!
signoff.fil: Tandaan: huminto, tumingin sa kaliwa at kanan, saka tumawid!
